profile.application: Research entry screen for a stiff UV-repairable coating on rigid wood
profile.origin: Analyst-selected demonstration requirements after exploratory reading; not an industry standard or a prospectively blinded material benchmark. Fixed before the independent reference and selector replay.
profile.decision_scope: Keep advances research only. Allows hot-melt fabrication and local photothermal heating. Initial film DMA is an explicitly permitted same-formulation proxy; visual closure may retain a shallow scar. No claim of finished coating qualification.
outside_entry_screen: statistical reliability of optical closure time
substrate thermal compatibility for a deployed product

glass-neat-modulus.locator: Main p. 3, Properties; p. 4 Table 1; p. 6 Characterization
glass-neat-modulus.context_review: Original pages establish the neat amorphous formulation, absolute dynamic flexural storage modulus, DMA three-point bending at 25 C, 1 Hz, heating 5 C/min; Table 1 identifies three measurements. The statistic denoted by plus/minus is unspecified.

glass-blend-modulus-cell.locator: Main p. 4 Table 1, 1.5-equivalent chain-stopper row, storage-modulus column
glass-blend-modulus-cell.context_review: Value and unit occupy separate table cell/header. Two source reviewers checked row, column and common DMA methods; no unit has been appended to the original cell.

glass-modulus-unit-header.locator: Main p. 4 Table 1, storage-modulus column heading

glass-optical-closure.locator: Main p. 5 optical-healing results; p. 7 Fig. 6a/b; p. 8 Optical healing methods
glass-optical-closure.context_review: First irradiation step closes a razor cut on a 300 micrometre neat-glass coating on wood under 320-390 nm, 500 mW/cm2 UV. A shallow scar remains; another exposure is described for scar removal. This observation is not strength recovery or repeated-repair durability. Local photothermal temperature reaches 188 C.

wang-RHP1-modulus.context_review: RHP-1 is the MBA/BDA 1/1.125 molar-feed formulation, with a semicrystalline contribution at 25 C. Storage modulus is reported, but required measurement mode, frequency and heating rate could not be verified because usable SI was not obtained. Thousands comma preserved.

wpu-water-trigger.locator: Main p. 14 section 3.4.5; exact formulation Fig. 8e/f p. 11
wpu-water-trigger.text: droplets of water were added on the scratch
wpu-water-trigger.context_review: Exact formulation WPU1/20P(HEMA-co-DMAM80) shows qualitative scratch closure after water addition and room-temperature evaporation. No timed UV-on-wood result is established.

wpu-other-formulations-DMA.locator: Supplement p. 2, DMA methods and Fig. S2
wpu-other-formulations-DMA.context_review: Supplement tests pure WPU1 and different 10-additive/WPU-solids formulations at 10 Hz and 3 C/min. These are not the selected 20-DMAM80 formulation or the required 1 Hz protocol; a duplicated caption is resolved only to the plotted labels and never used to transfer measurements.

burnworth-DMTA-protocol.locator: Main author-repository PDF p5 Full Methods: Mechanical testing; p2 thermomechanical discussion; SI p5 FigS4
burnworth-DMTA-protocol.context_review: The Zn0.7 material is one of the series tested by DMTA; p5 states all mechanical tests used dogbone samples, temperature sweep frequency1Hz and heating3C/min underN2. This is not declared as the required three-point bending at5C/min. Main p2 provides only a 53–60MPa range for the Zn0.7–1.0 series, not an exact scalar for Zn0.7. No numeric target value is asserted.

burnworth-optical-protocol.locator: Main author-repository PDF p2 Fig2c caption; p3 healing paragraph; p5 Film damaging and healing
burnworth-optical-protocol.context_review: Exact Zn0.7 formulation healed cuts in free-standing350–400micrometre films under320–390nm UV at950mW/cm2 in two30s exposures. This is not evidence of a target300micrometre wood coating at500mW/cm2 closing within30s. A total60s illumination is derived arithmetic and is deliberately not represented as a raw numeric observation.
